Hello! I am starting something where Avicus members can review DTM maps! Hopefully this can make it easier for the staff to see which maps are more liked by the community, and which ones are the least popular.
Just pick one map or more, and you can add what you want in your reply. I'll add updates later, like a google document where all the reviews will be for that one map. I may make more of these type of posts if it receives good attention and it helps. :)

replies.author: Cezbla
replies.body:
well if you want me to explain broken ages here it is:
It is a map inspired by broken world as you can tell from the name when I first made this map broken world was taken out so I decided I should take this time and make a good void map to come after broken worlds removal if you are wondering. this is a island based map. CreamyDohnut99 and I built this map it was our second map trail our first map we made was accepted. But some glitches screwed up the world so broken ages came first. Getting on the details of the map: This has 2 teams and 1 monument it is a harder map to get the monument which causes more strategy which this in fact makes it less popular because it is way to hard to get if there are defender's. The best way to get to the monuments are to go from tree to tree until you get to the other teams base and then you run for it. I had a question about the side islands and if they are important, this changes if you like more special armor not necessarily "OP" armor but you want the edge yes this is great but it comes with risk saying your on a tiny dome and you can get shot off... this is really all to the map it is a small map that I really liked to make it took about 2 days I hope this clarifies anything about this map you didn't know and I don't know if this isn't what the topic was about :D Sorry
Best regards.Cez
